retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1970s aesthetic featuring a central figure in motion with vibrant orange light trails against a deep black void.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic portrait of a person in a fringed garment, captured with a long exposure that creates a glowing orange motion trail. The subject is set against a pitch-black background, with typography clustered in the upper right corner featuring a marquee-style dot pattern.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's motion trail leads the eye from the bottom left toward the center
High contrast between the warm orange glow and the absolute black background
Text is anchored in the top right quadrant to balance the subject's leftward lean
Texture of the fringe garment is emphasized by directional lighting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left and center-bottom, leaning diagonally across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the primary orange light trail.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright orange trail on the left, follows the body's curve to the face, then moves to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space on the right and top edges.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the light trails against zero value in the background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a marquee effect where strokes are composed of circular dots
Secondary text uses a bold, tightly tracked sans-serif
Tertiary text uses a smaller, lighter weight of the same sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Dots in the marquee font are evenly spaced and follow the center of the stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A decorative marquee font paired with a clean, heavy-weight geometric sans-serif for readability.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the marquee dot aesthetic perfectly

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a person in a fringed orange outfit dancing against a black background. Use a long exposure to create a vibrant orange motion trail following the movement of the arms and torso. Ensure high contrast and deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the title in the top right corner using a marquee dot font in orange. Place the artist name and secondary text immediately below it in a bold white geometric sans-serif, left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the motion trail vibrant orange?
Is the text clustered in the top right?
Does the main title have a dot/marquee texture?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or record label logos
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify the motion trail looks like light painting
Check that the text is legible against the black
Ensure the fringe texture is visible in the highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: 70s Motion Portrait = (Long Exposure Subject + Fringe Texture) * (Black Background + Orange Light Trails) + (Top-Right Marquee Typography)
